instructions: This repository is an invoice NER system with a FastAPI backend, LayoutLMv3/LoRA inference, heuristic and Gemini fallback extraction, Docker/RunPod deployment scripts, and a Next.js frontend. Prioritize correctness, API contract stability, security around uploaded invoice/OCR inputs, model fallback behavior, and changes that could break deployment or observability. In every PR summary, include a section titled "PR Understanding Quiz" with 3-5 multiple-choice questions that test whether the author understands the important code paths, tradeoffs, and review risks in the PR. Each question must have four options labeled A-D. Immediately after the quiz, include a collapsible Markdown answer key using <details><summary>Answer key</summary> so the answers are readable after the author attempts the quiz.

rules.rule: API and inference changes must validate uploaded files, OCR JSON/TXT payloads, request size assumptions, and malformed input paths before processing.
Changes to extraction outputs must preserve or explicitly document the API response fields used by the frontend and tests, including invoice_number, extraction_method, total_words, and model_device.
Do not commit secrets, environment files, generated datasets, model weights, W&B runs, or large binary artifacts. Prefer DVC pointers or documented setup steps for model/data files.
Docker, docker-compose, RunPod, Triton, and frontend deployment changes must keep ports, environment variables, health checks, and model paths consistent across docs and scripts.
Behavioral changes to inference, validation, postprocessing, API routes, or frontend request handling should include focused tests or a clear explanation when tests are not practical.

Every PR summary should include a concise PR Understanding Quiz with 3-5 multiple-choice questions, four A-D options per question, and a readable collapsible answer key. Questions should focus on code and PR understanding, not trivia.
